responsibility: Implements gm2’s main statement/expression lowering from internal quadruples into GCC `Tree` form. It consumes quads, symbol-table metadata, and declared GCC objects to build assignments, calls, control flow, set operations, pointer indirections, string copies, unbounded-array helpers, and constant materialization; it also resolves constant expressions over quad ranges, updates symbol-table constant/constructor values, and uses `M2LexBuf` locations and `M2MetaError` diagnostics to keep generated trees tied to source positions.
same_name_distinction: Implementation module for the M2GenGCC pair: it realizes the exported quad-to-GCC-tree translation routines, building GCC trees, statements, and diagnostics from quads, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2GenGCC.def` only declares that interface.
